summary: Example portal sync frequencies: fast (development) every 5 minutes with a 30-second timeout, standard every hour with a 15-minute timeout, and slow every 4 hours with a 30-minute timeout, set on both orgsUsersTeams and jobTemplates schedules.
questions: How often should self-service portal sync run?
Can I sync the portal every 5 minutes?
Can sync frequency be set in hours?

answer_card.title: Portal sync frequency presets
answer_card.answer_md:
| Preset | frequency | timeout |
|---|---|---|
| Fast (dev) | `{ minutes: 5 }` | `{ seconds: 30 }` |
| Standard | `{ hours: 1 }` | `{ minutes: 15 }` |
| Slow | `{ hours: 4 }` | `{ minutes: 30 }` |

Set them on `sync.orgsUsersTeams.schedule` and `sync.jobTemplates.schedule`.
